meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后,当你说“重构”时,Claude 不会直接改代码,而是先弄清你的目标,分析相关文件和依赖,评估测试覆盖,再制定分步计划;每改一步就跑一次测试,出错就立刻停止并修复。它还会在你目标含糊或测试不足时反问澄清。
howto.when: 当你说出 “refactor”“cleanup”“restructure” 等触发词,或使用 /refactor 命令指定要重构的文件、符号、模式或描述时触发。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 里的验证逻辑提取成单独模块
say.note: Claude 先分析依赖再执行。

say.text: 用安全策略重构整个项目,先检查测试覆盖
重构所有使用已废弃 API 的函数,采用激进策略
say.note: Claude 会按计划分步改并验证。

howto.what_en: When you invoke refactor, Claude analyzes the codebase, checks tests, plans, then refactors step by step, running tests after each change and stopping on failure. It asks for clarification if the goal or scope is unclear or coverage is low.
howto.when_en: Triggers on words like "refactor", "cleanup", or "restructure", or when you use the /refactor command with a target file, symbol, pattern, or description.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes dependencies first, then extracts.

say_en.text: Refactor the whole project with safe strategy, after checking test coverage.
say_en.note: It pauses and asks if coverage is low.

say_en.text: Refactor all functions using the deprecated API with aggressive strategy.
say_en.note: Claude plans steps and verifies each one.
